//: @insolvia-ai/design-system lives in devDependencies on purpose: it
publishes raw .ts/.tsx source, so Vite always bundles it (vite.config.ts
ssr.noExternal) and the runtime never imports it — and keeping it out of
`dependencies` is what lets the Docker image's `npm ci --omit=dev` skip
it (and its clsx/tailwind-merge subtree, bundled at build time too) and
stay free of GitHub Packages registry auth. Installing it here DOES need
Never point this at a local checkout — not a file: path, not a link:. The
package lives in github.com/insolvia-ai/design-system and reaches this
site by published version only. That was already true here; it is now true
for apps/insolvia_app as well, which used to read the package's source
through a workspace symlink. Restoring a path override for either would
recreate the split channel the extraction removed.
